issueReference.title: Implement Work Runtime P1-7b task-backed replacement examples

reviewContext.userProblem: Existing replacement examples need proven task-backed lifecycle behavior before P1-7a legacy removal; the prior broad run failed 19 assertions, including one P1-7b example assertion.
requiredOutcomes: Complete and validate both deterministic replacement bundles.
Prove seven lifecycle cases through real WorkStore, TaskDispatch, WorkflowRunCommand and decision boundaries with positive counts.

Record final-source build, before-removal V1, affected focused and V11 tests, V8 mocks, strict touched-file SwiftLint, diff checks, source identity and serial broad regression with full logs and honest failure classification.
Obtain formal test-integrity, single adversarial and Astra combined-tree acceptance; refresh docs/progress; publish only exact reviewed paths after final gates.
nonGoals: P1-7a legacy workflow implementation removal or legacy example deletion in this slice.
Reconstruction of accepted P1-6a/b/c/d, new CLI/schema/orchestration abstraction, unrelated broad failure repairs, Monja work, broad formatting, lockfile regeneration or global plan archiving.
constraints: Use only immutable user-scope codex-design-and-implement-review-loop on feat/remaining-impl-plans; preserve accepted P1-6d HEAD and other session work.
Keep scratch and full logs under repository tmp; use a single owner for coupled bundles/tests and serial shared-source edits.
Before any later legacy deletion, require current-source passing V1 and exact ownership; no legacy deletion is authorized by this plan.
No reset, force push, broad stage, main merge or in-workflow worktree; classify failed broad gate honestly and repair new or P1-7b-owned failures.
Runtime production source edits require a bounded plan amendment and review.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Retain repair then required verification and one bounded director worker; these existing shapes limit change to demonstrated inconsistencies.
Use existing store fixture and real reservation, runner reconciliation and decision application; standalone mocks only supplement ledger evidence.
Keep coupled test/harness and bundles in one implementation plan; serial finalization owns shared documentation.
Defer publication until final verification, formal reviews and B4 documentation, resolving Step 5 feedback.
intentionalTradeoffs: Retain legacy examples during P1-7b so replacement evidence can be reviewed before a separately owned removal.
Allow unrelated broad failures only as explicitly classified failed follow-ups with formal slice-only review disposition; the broad command remains failed.
supportedEdgeCases: Rejected required gate followed by consumed recovery and bounded second attempt.
Guard stop with durable evidence and repeat dispatch.
Capacity zero with no attempt, canonical session or lease.
Child-only success against failed judged work.
Reopened-store once-only child accounting and invalid-output human escalation.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Repeated-finding guard behavior from the gate-visit fixture.
P1-7a removal and unrelated broad regression fixes.

addressedFeedback.resolution: Removed early commit and push checkpoint; publication follows verification, formal reviews and B4 documentation.

planningVerification.command: Author contract check: final-only publication, unchanged task DAG and historical body

acceptanceCriteria: Both replacement bundles validate and deterministic mock scenarios produce expected stable outputs.
Real task lifecycle tests prove acceptance, gate recovery, guard stop, capacity wait, bounded director decision, once-only child accounting and invalid-output human escalation with positive counts.
Before-removal V1 and affected focused suites pass on final source; build, strict touched-file SwiftLint, diff checks, source identity and serial broad regression have complete evidence.
Formal test-integrity, single adversarial and Astra combined-tree reviews accept no material P1-7b defect; docs/progress leave P1-7a, parent P1 and broad follow-ups open.
Only exact reviewed paths are committed and non-force pushed after all verification, review and B4 documentation gates.
